judged_text: GET /groups/:name/members changed its response shape from a bare serialized array (`render_serialized(members.to_a, GroupUserSerializer)`) to a `{members: [...], meta: {total, limit, offset}}` envelope, with the effective default page size dropping from 200/unlimited to 50. Out-of-tree API consumers and plugins that parse this public endpoint's response as a JSON array break silently (they receive an object and iterate nothing), with no versioning or compatibility shim in the diff.

adjudication.rationale: The diff verifies a breaking, unversioned API change in `GroupsController#members`: it switches from `render_serialized(members.to_a, GroupUserSerializer)` (a bare JSON array) to `render json: { members: ..., meta: ... }` (an object envelope) and introduces pagination defaults `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i`. Previously, non-automatic groups returned the full member list (no limit/offset applied) and automatic groups defaulted to 200. Core client code is updated (e.g., `Discourse.Group#findMembers` now reads `result.members` and `result.meta`), but any external consumer expecting an array would indeed break. This is an important compatibility/contract concern rather than an internal correctness defect.
